## Safety checklist

- [ ] Historical files remain preserved or changes are explicitly explained.
- [ ] No credentials, controller endpoints, or private configuration are included.
- [ ] Hardware remains disabled by default.
- [ ] Simulator results are not described as physical measurements.
- [ ] RL claims include a checkpoint, configuration, logs, and evaluation evidence.
